reguloj.name: semantic-colors-alias-palette
reguloj.statement: Semantic color tokens reference palette tokens instead of literal values.
reguloj.kialo: A palette change then reaches every semantic use in one place.

reguloj.name: spacing-owned-by-container
reguloj.statement: The space between sibling Eroj belongs to their container; an Ero carries no outer spacing.
reguloj.kialo: An Ero does not know its neighbours; if each brought its own distance, two side by side would add up.
reguloj.scope: eroj: butono instances in a design or in code

reguloj.name: external-link-marked
reguloj.statement: An Ero with the prop external marks the leaving of the application visibly and audibly: its Skemo carries an a11y text for external in de and en, and a decorative slot icon-end the projections fill with the mark.
reguloj.kialo: Leaving the application is a moment of trust; the person decides before, not after.
reguloj.scope: eroj: the Skemo of every Ero with a boolean prop external
